name: Toume Akira
source:
A classmate of the main character, she is a swimmer with a toned body.
She is a loner with a cool and cold personality.
She has no feelings for the protagonist and is indifferent to him.

However, as the virus progresses, she finds herself in a state of confusion as she goes beyond what she can tolerate and becomes disorganized.
